items.title: 9.8.2 Strong acids aur weak bases ke salts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.2, printed pages 204-205.

blocks.text: Strong acid aur weak base se bane salts (jaise ammonium chloride, NH₄Cl) mein strong acid ka conjugate base (Cl⁻) pani se react nahi karta. Lekin weak base ka conjugate acid (NH₃ se bana NH₄⁺) pani se react kar ke H₃O⁺ ions banata hai, aur solution acidic ho jata hai.
NH₄⁺ weak base NH₃ ka conjugate acid hai aur pani se react karta hai:
Cl⁻ strong acid HCl ka conjugate base hai aur pH par asar nahi karta.
NH₄⁺ ion ki wajah se solution acidic hai.

blocks.prompt: Equation ke saath batayein ke ammonium nitrate ka solution neele litmus ko surkh kyun karta hai.
blocks.explanation: NH₄NO₃ se NH₄⁺ aur NO₃⁻ bante hain. NO₃⁻ strong acid HNO₃ ka conjugate base hai aur react nahi karta, magar NH₄⁺ weak base NH₃ ka conjugate acid hai aur pani ko proton deta hai: NH₄⁺ + H₂O ⇌ NH₃ + H₃O⁺. H₃O⁺ solution ko acidic karta hai, is liye neela litmus surkh ho jata hai.

items: Strong acid + weak base ka salt (NH₄Cl): NH₄⁺ hydrolyse ho kar NH₃ + H₃O⁺ deta hai, Cl⁻ nahi; solution acidic.
